result.rationale: Ankle inversion sprain with negative Ottawa ankle rule criteria (no bony tenderness at malleoli/midfoot, able to bear weight four steps immediately and now), no deformity, open wound, or neurovascular symptoms. Appropriate for home management (rest, ice, compression, elevation, OTC analgesia) with instructions to seek care if unable to bear weight, worsening swelling/pain, numbness, or no improvement in several days.
